title: PowerPoint for desktop: Copilot edits presentations through chat for Copilot Chat users
summary: The documented policy paths, registry setting and sensitivity-label command check out. However, Microsoft does not establish that disabling Anthropic leaves PowerPoint editing available, so the page should remove that assurance before administrators rely on it.

claims.claim: Copilot creates presentations through conversation directly in PowerPoint.
claims.quote: Copilot in PowerPoint lets you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural conversation, directly in your presentation.

claims.claim: Set-Label -Identity <label GUID> -AdvancedSettings @{BlockContentAnalysisServices="True"} sets the label's content-analysis restriction in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: Set-Label -Identity "8faca7b8-8d20-48a3-8ea2-0f96310a848e" -AdvancedSettings @{BlockContentAnalysisServices="True"}

claims.claim: No admin UI is documented for configuring BlockContentAnalysisServices.
claims.quote: Searched: 'BlockContentAnalysisServices sensitivity label Microsoft Purview portal UI'; read Manage sensitivity labels in Office apps: 'This configuration isn't available in the Microsoft Purview portal. You must use the PowerShell advanced setting BlockContentAnalysisServices'.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The configured label excludes its content from Microsoft 365 Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
claims.quote: The setting lets you prevent content in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook ... from being sent to Microsoft for content analysis ... Although content with the configured sensitivity label will be excluded from Microsoft 365 Copilot in the named Office apps

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: That label setting does not exclude content from other Copilot scenarios such as Teams and Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: the content remains available to Microsoft 365 Copilot for other scenarios. For example, in Teams, and in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft 365 admin center path reaches the Anthropic user and group access setting.
claims.quote: select Copilot > Settings > View all. ... Select AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors. ... under Available subprocessors for your organization, select Anthropic ... Under Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no automation operation for the Anthropic provider user-access setting.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Anthropic AI providers operating Microsoft subprocessors user access Microsoft Graph PowerShell API settings'; '"Anthropic" "Graph" "subprocessor" settings API'. Read connect-to-ai-subprocessor and copilot-ai-provider-user-sec-group-access; neither documents this API.

claims.claim: Changing the Anthropic setting requires AI Administrator or Global Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be a member of the AI Administrator or Global Administrator role to perform this task.

claims.where: controls[2].governs; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Users can select Claude in Edit with Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps when they have access to that provider.
claims.quote: In capabilities such as Edit with Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps or Researcher, users can select Claude. ... When access is limited by user or group membership, only the assigned users can use Copilot features or agents that rely on that AI provider.

claims.claim: Claude models are on by default for most commercial-cloud customers outside the EU, EFTA and UK.
claims.quote: Microsoft enables Claude models on by default for most customers in commercial cloud (excluding EU/EFTA and UK).

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Claude models in Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary.
claims.quote: Claude models deployed in Microsoft offerings such as Microsoft Copilot, Researcher, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary

claims.claim: Claude models in these apps are excluded from in-country processing commitments where applicable.
claims.quote: are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary, and when applicable, in-country processing commitments.

claims.claim: The Anthropic setting controls model choice but cannot turn off the editing feature.
claims.quote: Searched: 'PowerPoint Edit with Copilot Anthropic disabled editing available OpenAI'; '"Edit with Copilot" "PowerPoint" "OpenAI"'. Read connect-to-ai-subprocessor and copilot-ai-provider-user-sec-group-access; neither states editing remains available.
claims.fix: Remove 'not whether editing is available' from controls[2].note and 'it does not turn the editing feature off' from Governance controls. Keep only the verified statement that the setting decides who can use Claude models.

claims.claim: Generative AI responses are not guaranteed to be fully factual.
claims.quote: The responses that generative AI produces aren't guaranteed to be 100% factual. ... users should still use their judgment when reviewing the output before sending them to others.

claims.claim: The supplied roadmap description names no new identity, permission or connection.
claims.quote: Copilot in PowerPoint lets you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural conversation, directly in your presentation. ... Available to Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license).

claims.claim: This change moves Copilot for the Copilot Chat population from answering questions about decks to changing them.
claims.quote: Searched: 'PowerPoint Copilot previously answering questions creating editing presentations before Edit with Copilot'. Read November 2023 archived release notes: chat editing already existed; no passage establishes the claimed previous limitation for unlicensed Copilot Chat users.
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence of Why it matters with 'The roadmap describes presentation editing for the Copilot Chat population, not only for people with a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.'

claims.claim: Microsoft says changes to the EU/EFTA/UK apps-only Claude setting take effect on 9 December 2026.
